response.description: Agentic Advisor Solution Accelerator for Azure HorizonDB is now generally available. You can use this financial services-focused reference solution to build multi-agent applications in Python using LangGraph and Mem0, with Azure HorizonDB as the data and intelligence layer. The accelerator demonstrates how you can combine advanced graph generation and querying, hybrid search with full-text search, DiskANN advanced filtering, and Azure HorizonDB AI functions to create more context-aware, explainable, and responsive advisor experiences. With this accelerator, you can jump-start development of agentic applications that reason over structured, unstructured, and relationship-rich data while using Azure HorizonDB's built-in AI capabilities to simplify retrieval, memory, and decision support workflows. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Agentic Advisor Solution Accelerator
